method: Native macOS SwiftUI ImageRenderer, 329 x 345 pt at 3x; the production view is copied to a temporary file with systemLarge injected and unavailable accessory comparisons excluded. Actions use a nonexecuting render stub.
limitations: Not a WidgetKit Home Screen host; accented/vibrant captures verify monochrome contrast, not wallpaper tint composition.
Accessibility cases select the production fallback but retain macOS font metrics; native iOS Dynamic Type verification remains required.
No intent is executed and no app, simulator, preferences or App Group data is read or changed.
typecheck: Real widget view and configuration typechecked for arm64 iOS17 simulator SDK with application-extension, strict concurrency and warnings-as-errors. Only unrelated Live Activity widget and intent implementation were stubbed; previews omitted.
